identity.name: Cathedral Carapace
identity.summary: A cream breastplate with broad copper ribs like roof arches.
identity.description: Reduces each enemy strike by 3 before block. Supplies 3 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage.
identity.lore: Built for the guardian of a sanctuary no army could enter.

effects.description: Reduces each enemy strike by 3 before block. Supplies 3 ward each round against poison, curse and reflected damage.
effects.condition: Equipped; class restriction satisfied; all activation costs can be paid together.

synergies.description: Orthogonal adjacency support and available mana/stamina determine the best arrangement. Strategic combinations grant no unlisted bonus.

conditions: All ingredients are packed, unlocked, nonpermanent and form one orthogonally connected group.
recipes.failureBehavior: Incomplete, disconnected or locked inputs consume nothing. A complete recipe always consumes its inputs; an output that cannot fit enters the stash.
recipes.description: Combine Amber Heart Pendant, Blacksmith's Apron, Pilgrim Crab, Salt Lantern into Cathedral Carapace.
